state.context: The design specifies a proposed row for CRUD when, yet leaves aggregate-query visibility during that check unstated. Ordered scenario effects and final invariants already have defined roles; handwritten JS targets disagree about creating before checking. Rent interval reports reveal another gap: each booking owns an interval array, and a query returns arrays of arrays. Existing pure reads offer immutable bindings, groups, ordered queries and duration totals, with no expansion operation or mutable collection builder.
state.candidate: Candidate admission semantics prepare normalized values including defaults, evaluate when using those proposed fields and the pre-write provisional store, and only then apply create/update. Commit invariants remain final-state checks. The JS library effect receives a pure when callback; source grammar is unchanged. Proposed flatten accepts a bounded collection of homogeneous collections and returns their elements in outer-then-inner order, exactly one nesting level. It preserves duplicates, rejects mixed types and performs no conversion. Empty input returns empty; every traversal and output bound applies, with explicit overflow failure.
state.actual_crud_examples:
crud Product by=product_owner fields=name,published create_fields=name,location,owner when=row.owner==actor and (row.location==null or can_work(actor,row.location)) delete=none
  crud Suggestion by=authenticated fields=title,description,category when=row.author==actor and not row.hidden and row.parent.published
  crud Vote by=authenticated fields=account create=none update=none delete=remove when=row.account==actor
  crud Grant by=coordinator fields=name,terms,questions,criteria,budget,closes,published create_fields=location,name,terms,questions,criteria,budget,closes,timezone when=can_work(actor,row.location) delete=none
  crud Application by=authenticated fields=title,description,answers,amount,reviewer create_fields=email,title,description,answers,amount,reviewer when=row.account==actor and row.state==draft and row.parent.published and now<=row.parent.closes delete=none

admission.instructions: Select the consistent meaning for CRUD checks while preserving the separate final-invariant responsibility.

criteria.prewrite: Prepare the candidate, check it against current state before applying its write, then stage the change. Field expressions use proposed values while collection counts retain pre-write membership.
criteria.staged: Apply the proposal provisionally before checking and discard it on rejection. Both fields and query counts observe the candidate and final invariants may cover similar ground.

flatten.instructions: Can this explicit bounded one-level expansion cover nested booking intervals without storage scaffolding or implicit flattening of all query results?
